gpu.description: GPU model, as named by the source

gpu_count.description: Number of GPUs represented by the source offer (e.g. 8 for an 8x machine)

vram_gb.description: VRAM per GPU in GB (not the machine total)

price_per_gpu_hour_usd.description: Normalized USD price for one GPU for one hour. If the source prices a whole multi-GPU machine, divide by its GPU count. Convert per-second or per-minute rates to per hour.

region.description: Region or location exactly as the source states it

price_type.description: on_demand (a listed or quoted on-demand price), starting_at (a 'starting at' / 'from' floor), estimated. Null if the source does not say.
